His father Miodrag (1926–1992) was a noted dramaturgist and poet who scripted several TV movies. He has directed several short films, only one of which is ("Mostar Sevdah Reunion" 2000) as well as two feature films, "Gori vatra" (2003), and "Kod amidže Idriza" (2004). In May 2008, he directed the music video for the duet "Dabogda" by Dino Merlin and Hari Mata Hari. In 2017, Žalica signed the Declaration on the Common Language of the Croats, Serbs, Bosniaks and Montenegrins. He is married to Bosnian actress Jasna Žalica and has one child with the actress.
